name: Aayush Gauba
description: Aayush Gauba is an AI researcher, cybersecurity developer, and open-source contributor whose work spans artificial intelligence, quantum computing, and theoretical computer science, and he has presented at conferences including PyCon US, DjangoCon US, and PyData. He also organizes PyData St. Louis and is passionate about building practical AI systems and growing the open-source community.

name: Sai Sriram Dubasi
description: Sai Sriram Dubasi holds an M.S. in Data Analytics Engineering and is a data and technology professional passionate about solving problems, optimizing processes, and creating meaningful impact. As a Co-host, he focuses on social media, community outreach, and bringing together students, professionals, and enthusiasts across the local Python, data science, and AI community. Beyond his tech career, he volunteers with NAMI and is passionate about fostering an inclusive community, encouraging collaboration, and creating opportunities for others to learn and grow.

name: Aarav Gauba
description: Aarav Gauba is a dedicated high school student with a strong interest in technology and design. During his high school years, he developed practical skills in both engineering and software development, using Autodesk Inventor to create 3D models of various objects and learning multiple programming languages, including Python, Java, HTML, and CSS. He is also a member of the National Honor Society and is deeply committed to giving back through community service events in the St. Louis area.
